PurposeFounder and management control board for customer account health, release confidence, revenue continuity, collections exposure, service recovery, trust posture, and retention or growth decisions.
Source ruleUpdate customer room, account review, credit, collections, trust posture, communication control, complaint, claims recovery, revenue forecast, cash forecast, and concentration source records first, then refresh this board.
Decision ruleDo not widen account growth, credit exposure, release speed, or outbound promise quality unless trust behavior, cash timing, claim posture, and commercial economics support the same answer.
